column1: # COG functional categories of Bakta annotations.
# Bakta writes the category letters of a CDS as /db_xref="COG:<letters>" in GenBank (beside the
# cluster ID, /db_xref="COG:COG0593"), as Dbxref=COG:<letters> in GFF3, and as /note="COG:<letters>"
# with --compliant. A CDS with two letters takes its first letter, as Bakta's own plot does.
# (public domain; read 2026-10-31). Hue families follow NCBI's four groups: information storage and
# processing (J A K L B), cellular processes and signaling (D Y V T M N Z W U O X), metabolism
# (C G E F H I P Q), poorly characterized (R S).
# Columns: feature_type, qualifier_key, value (case-insensitive regular expression), color, caption.
